summary: Omitted labeled arguments generate an unwitnessed computed-return TOP after local-module resolution
evidence: Native OCaml 5.3 fixture /tmp/arch-index-reviewer-label-qt01kV/label.ml defines M.f ~a ~b = if b > 0 then (fun c -> a + b + c) else (fun c -> c), then partial () = M.f ~b:1 2. The independently compiled UID probe reports body arity=2, supplied Some arguments=2, and Typedtree argument slots=3 (the omitted ~a is None). The new branch returns syntactic arity 2, but nargs at line 2150 is List.length args=3; line 2267 consequently emits a residual. Executed the current collector on the same CMT with the optional ownership context disabled and enabled: disabled emits only M.f/module_param/partial=true; enabled emits M.f/enumerated/partial=true plus *TOP*/callback_param/partial=false. The real candidate DB contains that extra MAY_TOP row. A fully supplied M.f ~a:3 ~b:1 2 control has supplied=3 and correctly needs its residual. A focused assertion requiring zero residuals for the omitted-label case fails exit 1 (1 !== 0). Thus the existing slot-count issue becomes a new observable precision regression in the changed qualified-head path, violating FR-007's syntactic-arity preservation and the witness rule requiring supplied arguments > body arity. The existing four native cases and all 34 fixed410 residuals pass, so they do not cover this case.
fix: Use actual supplied expression arguments (Some entries), rather than all Typedtree slots, for the new known-body saturation/overapplication decision. Preserve the partial head and add a native omitted-label regression with a fully supplied overapplication control; assert the residual count and pending partial metadata. Keep unrelated CFG behavior scoped separately.

summary: Omitted labeled argument slots are counted as supplied and fabricate a computed-return TOP
evidence: FR-007/AC-6 permits a computed-return residual only for overapplication. The implementation assigns nargs = List.length args and later emits TOP when nargs > head_arity. In the independent CMT reproducer `M.f ~b:1 2`, compiler evidence is supplied=2, slots=3, fn_arity=2; context-enabled collection emits the expected partial enumerated M.f plus a new *TOP*/callback_param, while context-disabled collection emits no computed-return residual. Existing native coverage tests positional under/overapplication only.
fix: Count only present (`Some`) arguments for the overapplication residual comparison, preserve result-arrow partial classification, add omitted labeled/optional-slot regression tests in both collector contexts, then regenerate and independently review fixed410 evidence.

fix: Add isolated negative tests for every FR-014 input, provenance, run-completeness, and witness-binding refusal branch, asserting the required nonzero exit class and no keep result.

summary: Omitted labeled-argument slots create a forbidden computed-return TOP residual
evidence: FR-007 requires eligible bodies to use fn_arity while preserving under/overapplication, and AC-6 requires the applied head and residual to respect syntactic arity (specs/tezos-call-resolution.md:58,75). The new local-module branch takes the body arity at lines 2172-2175, but nargs is List.length args at line 2150 and the overapplication residual is emitted from that comparison at lines 2264-2267. OCaml Typedtree retains an omitted optional/labeled argument as a None slot, so slot count is not supplied-argument count. The retained native fixture /tmp/arch-index-reviewer-label-qt01kV defines M.f ~a ~b with syntactic arity 2 and partial () = M.f ~b:1 2; its compiler evidence records two supplied expressions but three slots. My read-only query of its candidate.db found both the correct partial -> M.f MAY_ENUMERATED row and an additional partial -> *TOP* MAY_TOP/callback_param row. The fully supplied control also has the residual, so only the omitted-label case demonstrates the false residual. Existing tests at tezt/tests/local_module_targets.ml:104-109,183-196 cover positional partial/overapplication but not omitted labeled slots. This directly contradicts FR-007/AC-6; under the architect role, an acceptance-contract contradiction is critical even though it is conservative precision loss rather than an unsound exact target.
fix: For known syntactic body arity, compare arity with the number of supplied expression arguments (Some entries), not the number of Typedtree slots. Add a native omitted-label partial case and a fully supplied overapplication control that assert both the resolved head's partial metadata and whether a computed-return TOP residual exists. Keep the correction local to saturation/residual accounting.

Personally executed that producer and the equivalent exact SQLite query in a fresh owned temporary directory: both commands exited 0, yielding modules:25/functions:980/calls:6245. This golden still expects modules:25/functions:956/calls:6145; the exact comparison failed exit 1 with 'CI self-index exact golden mismatch'. The new counts agree with the independently refreshed origin-consumer reference, but that six-file recalibration never updated this separate CI oracle. The full 326-test suite passes because it does not execute this standalone CI golden comparison. Consequently the required CI job will deterministically fail before ship. HIGH denotes a required integration gate failure, not a semantic call-target defect; the mismatch originated with the original ownership feature and remains in the repaired head.
fix: Review and refresh only this self-index golden from the current built producer, following docs/adr/001-self-index-golden.md; retain the exact CI comparison and all product/refusal behavior. Rerun the smoke producer/query/golden comparison and required gates. Add this finding path to repair scope through the existing review-return process rather than changing CI or weakening its check.
